parsed.name: 质量流量计
parsed.description: 质量流量计用于测量气体流量，通常可输出质量流量、体积流量、压力与温度等参数，适用于实验室与工艺监测。该驱动上下文可能兼容多家厂商流量计型号，厂商不唯一时保持空值。
parsed.description_en: A mass flow meter is used to measure gas flow and commonly reports mass flow, volumetric flow, pressure, and temperature for laboratory and process monitoring. This driver context may cover multiple vendor model families, so manufacturer is left empty when not uniquely determined.

actions.description: 检查指定通信端口上是否连接了该流量计。
actions.description_en: Check whether this flow meter is connected on the specified communication port.

actions.description: 读取当前状态与测量值，如压力、温度、质量流量和体积流量。
actions.description_en: Read the current status and measured values, such as pressure, temperature, mass flow, and volumetric flow.

actions.description: 设置仪器当前使用的气体种类。
actions.description_en: Set the current gas type used by the instrument.

actions.description: 在仪器中创建一个自定义气体混合配置。
actions.description_en: Create a custom gas mixture configuration in the instrument.

actions.description: 删除仪器中的一个自定义气体混合配置。
actions.description_en: Delete a custom gas mixture configuration from the instrument.

actions.description: 锁定仪器面板按键，防止本机误操作。
actions.description_en: Lock the instrument front-panel buttons to prevent local accidental operation.

actions.description: 查询仪器面板按键是否处于锁定状态。
actions.description_en: Query whether the instrument front-panel buttons are locked.

actions.description: 对压力测量执行清零校准。
actions.description_en: Perform a tare operation on the pressure measurement.

actions.description: 对体积流量测量执行清零校准。
actions.description_en: Perform a tare operation on the volumetric flow measurement.

actions.description: 读取并清空待处理通信数据。
actions.description_en: Read and clear any pending communication data.

actions.description: 关闭与仪器的通信连接。
actions.description_en: Close the communication connection to the instrument.
